data.note: Monthly police street-level records, filtered using Parliament’s approximate constituency boundary. Locations are anonymised approximate points, not exact addresses. Counts are reports published in this dataset, not all crime or a measure of individual risk; boundary anonymisation can move points across the edge. British Transport Police records may be included. Reporting has a publication delay.
